entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence is 768 aa and begins with a hydrophobic 20-residue signal-peptide-like segment followed by a long low-complexity, Lys/Ser-rich region.
C-terminal region contains Biotin_carb_N (PF00289), CPSase_L_D2 (PF02786), ATP-grasp (PF02222), and Biotin_carb_C (PF02785) domains.
Homology matches reviewed plant biotin carboxylase proteins at 31.8–33.3% identity over about 66–68% of the query, with E-values around 10^-76 to 10^-77.

entities.name: Biotin carboxylase
observations: Biotin carboxylase catalyzes ATP-dependent carboxylation of enzyme-bound biotin on a biotin carboxyl carrier protein.
The reaction uses hydrogencarbonate and ATP and produces carboxybiotinylated carrier protein, ADP, phosphate, and a proton.
The domain architecture supports the biotin carboxylation module, but does not alone establish the ultimate carboxyl acceptor substrate.

entities.name: Biotin carboxylation reaction
observations: N(6)-biotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + hydrogencarbonate + ATP → N(6)-carboxybiotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
This is the first half-reaction of biotin-dependent carboxylases and is associated with Rhea RHEA:10505, RHEA:10506, and RHEA:13501.

entities.name: Biotin carboxylase cofactors
observations: Reviewed homologs bind two Mg2+ or Mn2+ ions per subunit and have ATP-binding and metal-ion-binding annotations.
